purpose: Describe optional, host-supplied visual layers for creative page compositions without defining a renderer or changing component behavior.

authority.relationship: Supplementary composition metadata only; the asset manifest remains the canonical source for asset provenance, approval, and distribution status.

runtimeBoundary.unknownFields: Consumers may preserve or ignore them; no runtime interpretation is promised.
runtimeBoundary.layerOrderMeaning: A proposed ordering hint for future composition tooling only; it does not prescribe DOM order, CSS stacking, or paint behavior.

fieldDefinitions.id: Stable logical identifier, not a file path.
fieldDefinitions.role: Intended visual purpose, such as background, frame, illustration, or foreground accent.
fieldDefinitions.source: Asset manifest logical ID or a repository-relative source reference; never an arbitrary remote URL.
fieldDefinitions.rights: Reference to the canonical asset record's provenance, license, and approval evidence; this field cannot grant rights.
fieldDefinitions.layerOrder: Non-negative integer ordering hint; ties have no defined resolution in this proposal.
fieldDefinitions.intrinsicDimensions: Positive pixel width and height, or an SVG viewBox expressed as four finite numbers with positive width and height.
fieldDefinitions.alt: Either meaningful text for informative imagery or an explicit decorative treatment; decorative layers must not carry essential content.
fieldDefinitions.fallback: Optional safe presentation when the layer is unavailable or disabled, including a neutral color or omission.

types.source: non-empty logical asset ID or repository-relative path
types.rights: non-empty reference to canonical asset record evidence
types.intrinsicDimensions: { width: positive number, height: positive number } or { viewBox: [finite, finite, positive, positive] }
types.alt: { treatment: 'informative', text: non-empty string } or { treatment: 'decorative', text: '' }
types.fallback: { behavior: 'omit' } or { behavior: 'solid-color', color: non-empty string } or { behavior: 'substitute', source: non-empty logical asset ID or repository-relative path }

safetyAndAccessibility: Resolve rights and approval from the canonical asset record; missing or pending evidence is not permission to distribute.
Do not embed executable markup, event handlers, external resource references, or baked interface copy in layer assets.
Informative image meaning must also be available as live accessible text; decorative layers must be hidden from assistive technology.
Fallbacks must retain readable content and must not encode semantic status using color alone.
This proposal does not authorize use of Moonwitness marks, characters, source references, or other consumer-owned material.

example.rights: See the matching record in moonframe-asset-manifest-v0.1.json; approval must be checked independently.
